title: **Video:** An Iraqi border guard gave a notable welcome to Iranian pilgrims arriving for the Arbaeen pilgrimage. He had a picture of the martyred Leader (Ayatollah Khamenei) affixed to his chest and made a symbolic hand gesture that mimicked the launching of Iranian missiles.
